text:
Alex K: quick FYI — PR #17241 (telemetry-instrumentation) is blocking the merge queue, failing intermittently in CI on macos-13 and windows-latest :grimacing:
Priya S: ah — is it the new session-metrics test or something else? any logs? :eyes:
Alex K: looks like `tests/telemetry/test_session_metrics.py::test_session_start` is timing out sometimes. seen on two different runs with different failures (timeout vs assertion). snippet:
```
E       AssertionError: expected 5 events, got 3
E       TimeoutError: wait_for_event timed out after 30s
```
Mateo R: CI Bot posted a failure, linking here:
CI Bot: buildkite/redwood-ci #17241 (macos-13) — failed `tests/telemetry/test_session_metrics.py::test_session_start` — logs: https://ci/redwood/17241/logs
Lina Z: does this reproduce locally for you, Alex? or is it flaky only in CI?
Alex K: can't repro locally on my macbook — ran 20x with `pytest -k session_metrics` no failures. appears cloud-only. maybe timing sensitivity under build container.
Priya S: could be env variable or network mock ordering. Did we change the fake-time patch in the last commit?
Alex K: no, only added a small instrumentation call. suspect the test relies on ordering of two async callbacks.
Mateo R: plan: do a targeted CI rerun for the two failing shards first, then if it still flakes, add a short retry in test harness and open a follow-up to harden the assertion.
Lina Z: can we avoid snapshot update here? this is logic, not visual.
Alex K: agreed — no snapshot. requesting a targeted rerun now. @CI Bot can you rerun just the macos and windows jobs for #17241? :pray:
CI Bot: Received rerun request for buildkite/redwood-ci #17241 — re-queueing jobs: macos-13, windows-latest. ETA ~6m :robot_face:
Mateo R: while rerun is running, can someone approve the PR for merge-on-green? we prefer not to block other queued PRs. @Priya S can you give non-blocking approval so it can merge if rerun passes?
Priya S: I can give an approval but will add a reviewers-note: "approve for merge-on-green, please revert if telemetry regression observed in canary". giving :thumbsup: now.
Alex K: thanks — giving a heads-up to infra too in case it's cluster-related. Lina, can you watch metrics for the canary once it goes out?
Lina Z: yep will monitor latency and error rates for session metrics for the next 2 hours. set an alert if error rate >0.5% :white_check_mark:
CI Bot: macos-13 job finished — success. windows-latest job finished — flaky failure reproduced: same test timed out.
Alex K: OK repro on windows. I'll push a short fix to add a tighter wait and more logging, then open a follow-up PR. for the current PR, can we merge-on-green with the macos green and windows flaky recorded?
Mateo R: SGTM — log the flakes in the PR and mark as non-blocking. we should also schedule a small tech-debt ticket to remove flakiness.
Priya S: approved for merge-on-green. please include the failure details in the PR description and link the follow-up ticket when created.
Deploy Bot: merge-on-green enabled for PR #17241. It will auto-merge when all required checks pass.
Alex K: thanks all — I'll open the follow-up ticket (telemetry: stabilize session metrics test) after this merges and ping infra to look at windows images. back to you, CI :rocket:
Mateo R: thanks Alex, Lina, Priya. keeping this thread in case it flaps again.
